text:
Sandeep: Quick sync — finalizing the RFC review session for Thu 10:00am PT (40m). Need to lock the order of presenters, assign two reviewers, and pick a note-taker/timekeeper. Can people confirm availability and volunteer?

Jess R: I can take notes. Suggest we put the infra gating RFC first — it unblocks a handful of PRs.

Dave L: I can review infra gating and act as backup for QA metrics.

Maria K: I'm OOO Thu morning. I can still pre-read and leave comments by Wed EOD. If someone can present for me that would be great.

Alan W: I can present Maria's RFC if she drops a 2–3 slide TL;DR in the doc. Also propose we timebox each talk (8m + 8m discussion pattern) so we don't run over.

Sandeep: Proposed runbook/order (please ack or suggest swaps):
```
1) Infra gating RFC — presenter: Alan W
2) Realtime batching design — presenter: Jess R
3) QA metrics & alerts — author: Maria K (Alan W presenting)
4) Canary rollout playbook — presenter: Dave L
```

Jess R: sgtm. If folks prefer, I can swap 1/2. Also need a Zoom link — calendar-bot, can you create the event?

calendar-bot: Event created: "RFC review — Thu 10:00-10:40 PT". Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/123456789 (passcode in calendar invite).

Maria K: Leaving my quick notes here for whoever presents (very short):
- Goal: define metrics that gate promotion
- Must-haves: alert thresholds + runbook steps
- Known risk: sampling lag on nightly jobs

Sandeep: Thanks, Maria — Alan, can you pick up presentation then?

Alan W: Yep, will add 2 slides and drop them in the doc by Wed 1pm PT.

Dave L: I'll be reviewer for the canary playbook. Also volunteer to be timekeeper if needed.

Jess R: I'll be note-taker and start the notes doc. Please add bullet highlights in the doc before Wed EOD if you want them read out.

notes-bot: Notetaking doc created by Jess R: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfc-notes/2195012345

Sandeep: One last ask — reviewers: if you find a blocker, prefix the comment with `BLOCKER:` so we can triage that first during the meeting. Otherwise add inline comments and use status tags.

Maria K: Posted comments in the doc and left a short TL;DR. Thanks all for covering the presentation.

Jess R: Copy. I'll ping in #eng 15m before start to remind folks and paste the Zoom link.

Dave L: :thumbsup: See you Thu.

Sandeep: :thumbsup: Closing order as-is unless someone flags a swap by Wed noon. Thanks!
